Welcome to Adorn

The guides to Adorn and Adorn Seller Framework.

This wiki covers Adorn and Adorn Seller Framework: installation, everyday use, author tools and technical reference.

Adorn#

Browse your installed outfit collection, combine pieces into custom looks and inspect the result in the 3D preview. Dress individual NPCs, factions or mixed groups, keep a personal wardrobe and share assignment contributions.

  • Getting started
  • Browse outfits and use the preview
  • Assign looks to NPCs and factions
  • Use your wardrobe
  • Share assignments
  • Troubleshooting

Adorn Seller Framework#

Give selected looks a place in the adventure. Find the assigned seller, solve their request and earn finished pieces or learn to craft them. Authors can create the conversation, record replies and set the recipe and challenge rules.

A tailor, a demanding collector, or a follower with an unusual side business.

Before you begin#

Check the requirements for your role. Ordinary players using prepared ASF content do not need the dialogue-build toolchain or an API key.

These guides describe the current implementation. Read the release and testing status for the in-game acceptance work still outstanding.
